title: Query semantic equivalence across supported execution plans
purpose: Find reachable query-engine result or acceptance divergences between supported plans for the same logical query at an equivalent fixed snapshot/horizon and served index type/version. Follow the companion evidence and ownership contract. Compare against an independent non-empty oracle; agreement between implementations sharing helpers is insufficient. This is not model-driver coverage implementation, a temporal consistency audit, wire translation review, or accounting arithmetic audit. Unsupported plans and undocumented equivalence remain questions, not presumed bugs.
invariants: Every comparison must establish the same ledger, supported target, logical predicate, bound parameters, result mode/options, entity universe, fixed data horizon and served index version/type. Record the actual entry points and selected plans. Separate documented surface defaults, unsupported combinations and temporal visibility exceptions before asserting equivalence.

Compile and CompileReverse must preserve accepted predicates and their selected entity set for ACCOUNTS, TRANSACTIONS and LOGS under the per-target validity contract. Direction changes ordering, not membership. Compare each against independently expected identities as well as against the other; a shared compiler helper can make both wrong.

AND range coalescing, equality shortcuts, OR union and NOT difference must preserve the predicate over the established target universe, including overlapping branches, duplicates, absent metadata, null-derived index entries and empty intersections. Coalescing must also preserve acceptance: each leaf is validated against the served type before a merge can drop its bound, and validation, merging and leaf compilation share the one version a compilation resolves per index, even when a promotion flush lands mid-compile. NOT is not merely inequality among rows with the field present. Do not invent SQL null semantics.

Metadata comparisons and existence conditions must use the served index version-bound coercion contract while entity enrichment preserves raw primary values. Distinguish missing keys, explicit NullValue and failed conversion, includeNull, false, zero and empty strings; preserve signed/unsigned and datetime bounds without overflow or silent narrowing.

Absolute Seek, exhaustion/reseek, materialized and streaming leaves, and ascending/descending pagination must return the independently expected ordered window with exclusive continuation and correct lookahead on a frozen dataset. Repeated pages must neither duplicate nor omit matches in that fixed state; no cross-request snapshot guarantee is inferred under concurrent writes.

The log-date streaming plan relies on ledger-log dates being nondecreasing with log IDs, including mirror-ingest and skipped logs; equal dates use the ID key suffix. Transaction inserted_at has no such guarantee because mirror ingest preserves source dates and must retain the general plan.

Prepared execution must select the same entities as direct execution of the bound stored predicate where target, effective ordering, horizon and options are equivalent. Parameters must retain their supported type and bound semantics; unsupported target/mode or unavailable indexes must follow established rejection contracts, not be interpreted as empty successful results.

Prepared-query LIST execution applies the shared zero-to-100 and above-1000-to-1000 page-size policy before ID collection, entity enrichment and response materialization, reports the effective size, and preserves independently expected ordered windows and both continuation directions. AGGREGATE_VOLUMES remains independent of the LIST page cap. Adapter input translation belongs to api-boundary-contracts; this invariant applies to canonical typed executor inputs, including direct/controller callers.

Where supported, main-store-only and indexed plans, and nil-filter aggregation shortcuts and equivalent account enumeration, must preserve membership and result shape for the same input/options. Compare aggregate bucket keys as well as values, including zero buckets and metadata-only accounts. Accounting arithmetic itself belongs to accounting-invariants. Metadata filters require a declared field and ready index; this contract creates no index-free server fallback.

Iteration or materialization errors must remain errors rather than successful truncated results where the query-engine contract requires propagation. Follow the concrete consumer; wire encoding and stream framing ownership stays with api-boundary-contracts.

Canonical decoded cursors preserve exclusive forward and backward windows in query order on a fixed dataset, including nonexistent resume keys, empty resumed pages, lookahead and capped upstream sources. Cursor filtering, prefix skipping, reversal and collection preserve required iteration errors; clean EOF is not inferred from a failed read. Wire token acceptance/encoding and stream framing remain owned by api-boundary-contracts.

Every QueryFilter oneof arm and QueryTarget has an explicit independently checked acceptance verdict. Descriptor annotations, protoc-gen-queryfilter-validity output and engine consumers must agree, but their agreement alone cannot establish the intended target matrix. Missing, contradictory or unknown-target annotations fail generation rather than silently producing permissive or all-false defaults.

Exact transaction address predicates select immutable account-to-transaction mappings for ANY, SOURCE and DESTINATION independently of current account existence, in both directions and with hardcoded or parameterized input. Account-target exact matching and transaction prefix matching retain their current-account universe; do not infer historical prefix support.
adversarial_questions: Which production caller selects each compared plan, and can both execute for this target, predicate and served type/version? Is a supposed divergence merely a different direct/prepared sort default or a missing required index?
Can two directions or direct/prepared execution agree on the wrong result because the oracle reuses Compile, range merging, coercion, encoding or production predicate evaluators?
Does NOT complement the full supported target universe when some entities lack the key, hold failed conversions, or match multiple OR branches?

Can merging inclusive/exclusive bounds, equal endpoints, contradictory ranges or integer extrema change an empty set into a singleton/universe, including parameterized bounds that intentionally bypass merging?
Do Seek after exhaustion, sparse intersections, overlapping address unions and page size one preserve exact identities in both directions?

Can a direct prepared-query executor request with page size 0, 1000, 1001 or uint32 maximum bypass the effective LIST size before enrichment, return an oversized cursor or corrupt next/previous traversal in either direction? Does applying the LIST policy accidentally truncate an aggregate?

Can any reachable ledger-log creation path assign a date that regresses as the per-ledger log ID advances, or does a mirror source date leak into the log date instead of remaining on the mirrored transaction?
Does runtime parameter resolution preserve hardcoded semantics at min/max and type boundaries without assuming identical error precedence when several inputs are invalid?
Is a mismatch in query selection, temporal projection alignment, wire conversion or accounting arithmetic? Which single neighboring domain owns its correction?
Is this failure reachable at the audited SHA, already fixed historically, or already owned by an open PR/qualified finding? What evidence would disprove it?

Can pagecursor.ReadReverse, Page or Links, cursor.SkipWhile/Filtered/Reverse/Collect, or a consumer lose a row, duplicate the exclusive key, reverse the returned page twice, or lose MoreReporter evidence from a capped source? Which actual production wrapper chain must carry that evidence?

Can an empty resumed forward page fail to navigate to the tail, an empty resumed backward page fail to navigate to the head, or lookahead emit a continuation without another row? Are expected windows independently sliced rather than computed with production page helpers?

If generator output and all compilers agree, can a wrong descriptor target annotation still admit or reject the wrong condition? Does the independent per-target matrix include every arm and target, deliberately valid-on-none arms and rejection of malformed declarations?

After an EPHEMERAL cell purge, can a current-account existence probe hide retained funding or draining transactions in either exact compiler direction? Do role, parameter, boolean and pagination variants preserve independently expected identities while prefixes remain current-account based?
dynamic_checks_to_consider: Exercise Compile and CompileReverse through compile_leaf_resolution_test.go, compile_metadata_resolution_test.go and compile_id_resolution_test.go against independent expected identities. The leaf suite also asserts address/reference parameter failures, readiness precedence and address-role refusal classes; the metadata and ID suites assert identities only. Use compile_error_parity_test.go for its target/shape/depth, metadata schema/type and index-readiness refusal cases, not as comprehensive metadata/ID parameter-refusal coverage. Cover literal/parameter address roles, reference/asset prefixes, metadata false/null arms, absent ID points and exclusive ID ranges; shared resolvers must not become their own oracle.

Build a finite independently enumerated non-empty fixture per supported target with known matching and nonmatching identities; compare each actual plan to exact sets and ordered pages, recording selected branches and cardinalities.

Cross typed metadata with absent/NullValue/conversion failure/zero/false/empty, signed and unsigned extrema, datetime microsecond boundaries, includeNull and boolean compositions. Independently calculate expected coercions for chosen cases rather than calling production conversion helpers.

Compare hardcoded and equivalently bound prepared predicates, ascending and descending compilation, coalescible, nested and unmerged equivalent ranges (including bounds the served type rejects), and supported nil-filter/main-store paths. Pin dataset, version and options; explicitly mark unavailable server plans.

Exercise absolute seek before/at/between/after matches, reseek after exhaustion, one-row and exact-page-size windows, duplicate OR hits and sparse AND/NOT, with an independent sorted expected sequence.

Use real query.Execute with a non-empty fixture exceeding 1000 matching entities to compare page sizes 0/1000/1001/uint32 maximum in both directions against independently ordered exact identities. Assert effective cursor size, bounded enrichment, next/previous continuation and complete traversal; keep aggregate witnesses proving all candidates remain included. Use executor_page_size and executor_aggregate tests as evidence leads, not helper-only policy tests.

Exercise log-date pages with equal HLC dates, mirror-ingest logs, skipped logs, and sparse ID intersections; confirm transaction inserted_at with inverted mirror source dates retains correct ordered pagination.

Use existing compile_reverse_parity, compile_bounds, compile_and_merge, params, executor_aggregate and readstore iterator conformance/error tests as evidence leads. Inspect assertions and production reachability; green tests or historical fixes alone are not proof. Record exact commands actually run and unexecuted proposals separately.

Use a fixed independently sorted sparse sequence such as IDs 2, 5, 9, 14, 20 and explicit string-key witnesses. Enumerate expected pages by slicing that sequence, then drive actual supported controller/executor consumers in both query orders and both navigation directions, sizes one, exact and partial windows, keys on/between/outside matches, and last-page back cursors. Assert complete traversal, exact row order, links and round trips; never compute expectations with Page, Links, ReadReverse or the skip predicate under test.

Exercise empty resumed pages in each direction and follow their recovery link; check lookahead consumed only for continuation detection, source-reported more at an exact upstream cap, and wrappers used by the real routed source. Inject an error before any row, after a partial page and while probing lookahead; distinguish EOF from failure and verify no falsely successful complete result. Close/resource ownership and transport framing defects are handed to their owning domains.

Independently enumerate QueryFilter arms and targets from protobuf descriptors and a manually justified expected acceptance matrix. Compare annotations, generated kinds/table and supported typed compiler acceptance, including nested predicates. With temporary descriptor fixtures, require generation failure for omitted declarations, contradictory declarations and unknown target numbers; deliberately valid-on-none arms must remain explicitly rejected. Separate generated completeness from correctness of the intended matrix.

Fund then drain an EPHEMERAL account with and without metadata; require ANY=funding+drain, SOURCE=drain, DESTINATION=funding in both directions and page-size-one traversal, even when current attributes are absent. Preserve reference and transaction-metadata controls and an empty prefix result for the absent account.
